rawValueNote: Generated markup must reference catalog tokens, never raw values. This is a convention for downstream code generation: no PageSpec field carries style values, so nothing in a PageSpec can violate it.

overrides.statement: The PageSpec schema has NO per-instance style/token override field (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Styling is owned by section/component contracts. There is deliberately nothing to validate or mutate at the PageSpec layer for token overrides.

fontPolicy: System font stacks only. Do not load web fonts; JetBrains Mono is declared by the intro but never loaded on the real site.
pinnedAssetPolicyNote: Compliance pins for asset/link roles live in extraction/verify_all.py PINNED_ROLES.
